newsitem.title: UK: Honda says will stay in UK even if outside EMU.
newsitem.headline: Honda says will stay in UK even if outside EMU.

text.p: Japanese car manufacturer Honda said it will keep its operations in Britain even if the UK stays out of a single European currency, The Times newspaper said on Wednesday.

It reported Kentaro Kato, Honda's European executive vice-president in charge of manufacturing, saying there is no intention of changing the company's investment strategy in view of European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), due to start on January 1 1999.

"We operate in many countries which means in every part of the world we try to avoid currency fluctuations. Therefore, there is no intention to change investment strategy if they join or not," the paper quoted Kato as saying.
In recent weeks a number of senior executives from multinationals have warned that foreign investment in British businesses may be hit if the UK stays outside EMU.
